author: evac
description: Ambient anime-character card collecting. Cards drop as the channel talks; press the button under the card you want, and when the draw closes each card goes to one of the people who picked it (people who already own a card only win it if nobody who doesn't picked it too, and a losing streak raises your odds). Collect, wishlist, complete series sets for a wondercoin bonus, request characters, trade, sell duplicates for wondercoin, and build a gallery.
install_msg: Thanks for installing cardcollect! Admins: run `.card settings` to open the settings panel and pick the drop channel (and, optionally, a private admin-only channel for member card requests), then build the pool: `.card importseries <name>` imports a whole series (search AniList, pick the match, review a dry-run preview with a numbered picture grid and rarities, fix bad art by uploading a replacement image or open Adjust and delete the line of any character you don't want, or type `skip 4-9`, then press Import), `.card importpool <count> [any|female|male]` bulk-imports characters spread across rarity tiers (safe to re-run; run only one at a time), or `.card addcard` adds one by hand. Open any card with `.card find <name>` to change its rarity, replace its art or retire it. Use the Testing tab in `.card settings` (Test mode, then Post a test drop) to try a full draw before going live; test draws award nothing. How a drop works for members: press the button under the card you want (one pick each, changeable until the draw closes, default 90s, set in `.card settings`). Every reply is private. Each card goes to a random picker, but a member who already owns it only wins if nobody who doesn't (or who has room for a spare) picked it, and every contested loss in a row adds a 25% weight bonus (up to 2x). Members also get `.card` (collection, series sets and wishlist tabs), `.card find`, `.card daily`, `.card give`, `.card sell` and up to 3 showcase slots (`.card showcase`). Members can hold one tradeable spare; a win beyond that becomes a sell token. Run `.card diagnostics` after a few days live to get sizing suggestions for drop_chance/drop_cooldown_seconds.
short: Ambient anime-character card collecting: pick the card you want from each drop and the draw decides.
name: cardcollect
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per member, their card collection, showcase cards, wishlist, completed series sets, pending sell tokens and daily-pull streak. Drops and in-progress draws are kept in memory only. This data is stored locally in the bot's data folder and is not shared externally.
